long_biography.plain_text:
A shortage of well-supported leisure boats in Mexico gave Roberto Aboumrad and his brother Jorge a concrete business problem to solve. They began importing craft, then developed Performance Boats into a network combining sales with maintenance, storage, insurance, brokerage and yacht management.

Decades of listening to owners shaped their next decision. The brothers created Alpha Yachts because the available market did not deliver the layouts and family-oriented spaces they wanted. Roberto now leads the builder while remaining involved in design and product development. Production in Italy has taken the family business from distributing established brands to building its own custom yachts for an international market.
